## 📄 Specification: Bookmark Manager
`specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md` — all quality checks pass.

### What the app does (in scope for v1)
| Priority | User story |
|----------|-----------|
| **P1** | **Save a bookmark** — enter a URL, optional title & tags; it appears in the list |
| **P2** | **Browse & search** — find links by keyword across title, address, and tags |
| **P3** | **Edit & delete** — correct titles/tags, remove with confirmation |
| **P3** | **Organize with tags** — filter the list down to one tag |

### Key requirements
- Validates web addresses; derives a title when none is given
- Opens destinations in a new tab
- Live search as you type; clear empty states
- **Persists** bookmarks across close/reopen
- Warns on duplicate URLs

### Success criteria (measurable)
- Save a bookmark in under 20s; find one among 100+ in under 5s
- Search/filter responds within 1s up to 1,000 bookmarks
- 100% persistence across restarts

### Notable scope boundaries (in Assumptions)
- **Single user, one device; no login** in v1
- **No sync, no browser import/export** in v1
- Browser-based web app; no page-preview fetching or link-liveness checks

---
